scope: Player birthday backend, with no automatic callers, menus or events

storage.location: SaveBlock2 0xF18..0xF1F, formerly the last eight bytes of filler_B20
storage.format: 32-bit format signature, month/day packed into 16 bits, and 16-bit complement
storage.compatibility: SaveBlock2 stays 0xF24 bytes and encryptionKey stays at 0xF20. Zeroed, unsigned legacy, malformed and inconsistent registrations are treated as unregistered. No event or new-game caller added.
storage.evidence: Repository and adjacent tool searches found no uses of filler_B20 or explicit 0xF18/0xF1C save offsets. GNU ARM compilation checks actual SaveBlock2 offsets and size. Existing native save section includes all 0xF24 bytes.

behavior: Set accepts full-width script inputs and rejects invalid month/day without changing an existing registration
Get returns false for absent or malformed data; optional output pointers are untouched on failure
February 29 is valid for registration and matches only February 29 of Gregorian leap years
IsToday uses the currently populated gClock, so existing real-time/play-time mode determines the date
Script entry points expose set/get/clear/today for later use without wiring any callers
verification: check_birthday.py executes production source against a native controlled save/clock fixture
All 65536 byte month/day pairs, upper 16-bit input ranges and packed save dates checked
All 65536 u16 years compared against Python calendar.isleap
All 64 single-bit corruptions rejected; surrounding save bytes and encryption key preserved
Script set/get/clear/today, unregistered state and null save pointer covered
Full GNU ARM audit: 204 translation units, 180 compiled and 24 stopped at unavailable generated headers
limitations: Actual flash persistence, old-save migration and GBA runtime are not exercised. Save-layout assertions and controlled memory tests do not prove full-game runtime compatibility. No birthday rewards were requested or added.
